summary: Evening update: the jail roster and city arrest logs could not be re-read this evening, so booking counts are as of about 5 a.m. The sheriff's office says Tuesday's first-degree sodomy arrest near Foley followed an assault call; Daphne police say a man is charged with a felony drug count after gunfire calls in Lake Forest, and the 19-year-old charged in Sunday's Foley attempted kidnapping is booked on a first-degree kidnapping charge.

entries.title: Felony drug arrest after gunfire calls, Daphne: Luis Cortes-Espana
body: Daphne police received several calls at about 7 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, reporting gunshots in the Lake Forest subdivision and traced them to a home in the 100 block of Hillcrest Circle, where officers found spent rifle casings on the rear deck and ground, FOX10 and WKRG reported, citing police. Police said three intoxicated adults at the home were believed to have been firing into nearby woods; no one was hurt.

After getting a search warrant, officers seized a semi-automatic Draco pistol and about 27 grams of cocaine, police said, according to FOX10. Luis Cortes-Espana, 23, was arrested at 12:46 a.m. Monday and charged with unlawful distribution of a controlled substance, which police described as a Class B felony; Alabama law allows 2 to 20 years in prison for a Class B felony. Police said the investigation is ongoing and more charges may follow.
The jail roster shows him released Nov. 17.

entries.title: Kidnapping booking: Johnnie Joel Duarte-Olarte
body: Johnnie Joel Duarte-Olarte, 19, named by FOX10 as charged in the Nov. 15 attempted kidnapping at a Foley convenience store, was booked into the Baldwin County jail Nov. 16 under the sheriff's office, according to the jail roster, which gives an arrest time of 8:05 p.m. Nov. 15.

The roster lists one booked charge, first-degree kidnapping — abducting someone to harm, terrorize or hold them; the court complaint reported by FOX10 charges attempted first-degree kidnapping. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Child sex-abuse arrest: Kendrick Lebarron Taylor-Ezell
body: Kendrick Lebarron Taylor-Ezell, 33, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office on Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on charges of sexual abuse of a child under 12 — sexual contact with a young child — and sodomy by force. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Sodomy arrest: Clyde Earnest Douglas
body: Clyde Earnest Douglas, 58, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office on Tuesday, Nov. 17, after deputies answered an assault call at a residence in an unincorporated area near Foley at about 9 a.m., the sheriff's office said, as reported by FOX10 and NBC 15 on Wednesday. Deputies detained him at the scene; the sheriff's office said investigators conducted interviews, including one with Douglas, and determined a sexual assault had occurred in addition to the reported physical assault.

He was booked on a charge of first-degree sodomy — a forcible or non-consensual sexual act. The jail roster gives an arrest time of 9:30 a.m. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Shooting into occupied building arrest, Loxley: Albert Koen
body: Albert Koen, 56, was arrested by Loxley police at 11:47 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, according to the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a charge of shooting into an occupied building — firing a gun into a building with people inside. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Terrorist threat arrest: Tedd Stone
body: Tedd Stone, 60, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office on Tuesday, Nov. 17, and booked early Wednesday, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

He was booked on a charge of making a terrorist threat in the second degree — threatening violence to frighten people or disrupt a place or service. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Eluding and DUI arrest, Foley: Larry Arthur Paredes
body: Larry Arthur Paredes, 33, was arrested by Foley police at 8:14 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.

He was booked on charges of attempting to elude police — fleeing an officer who signaled a stop — and driving under the influence of alcohol. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Protection-order violation arrest: Shawn Derek Wilson
body: Shawn Derek Wilson, 39, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 11 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, according to the jail roster, on a charge of violating a domestic-violence protection order — breaking a court order to stay away. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 15–17: Suzanne Nichole Birnstiel, Ryan Anthony Wiggins, Amy Lee Pollock, Shea Eddie Stephens, Damien Sharell Howard and others
body: The sheriff's office arrested Suzanne Nichole Birnstiel, 44, at 5:07 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, on charges of felony failure to appear, promoting prison contraband (drugs) — bringing drugs into a jail — and methamphetamine possession; she was in custody early Wednesday. Fairhope police arrested Ryan Anthony Wiggins, 41, at 10:18 p.m. Sunday in the area of Bernie's Way on methamphetamine, marijuana and paraphernalia charges, according to the city log and the roster; he was in custody.

On Monday, the sheriff's office arrested Amy Lee Pollock, 38, on a menacing charge — threatening someone with a weapon — and Shea Eddie Stephens, 38, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol; both were released Nov. 17. Bay Minette police arrested Billy David Chavous, 30, and Tracy Leigh Caine, 53, at 9:25 a.m. Monday on methamphetamine possession charges, and the sheriff's office arrested Jacob Andrew Hickey, 44, on marijuana and paraphernalia charges; all three were released.

On Tuesday, Bay Minette police arrested Damien Sharell Howard, 23, on a cruelty-to-animals charge, and the sheriff's office arrested Cameron Jacob Bradley, 19, on charges of resisting arrest and obstructing governmental operations, and John Leo Miller, 60, on drug possession and paraphernalia charges; the roster shows all three released Nov. 17. All information is from the jail roster unless noted.
